hook.name: MultiPoolsHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable swap fee (30–500 bps) on ETH-input swaps, rising to 30% during a 60-second antisniper launch window. Collected fees are routed to creator, buyback/burn, rewards, and platform. LP additions are restricted to a designated autoLpSeeder after the initial seed, and LP removal is permanently blocked.
